question: Does awarding one final Mandate per Facility in the latest powered Production snapshot make infrastructure investment competitive without creating faction, profile, seat, opening, or winning-path dominance?
requiredDiagnostics: profile and faction win shares by supported player count
powered and offline Facility counts by profile
Core Action and Program selection frequencies
AGI funnel and World Ending rates

selectionRule.candidatePreferred: Select the candidate only if the four-player infrastructure profiles improve without exceeding registered profile, faction, interaction, or pairwise bounds, and three- and five-player guards introduce no credible regression.
selectionRule.canonicalPreferred: Retain canonical scoring if the bonus rewards incidental Facilities, creates a compulsory Build line, amplifies Vertical or Foundry beyond the faction bound, or fails to improve infrastructure viability.
selectionRule.interpretation: The one-lever result may select a candidate for human review. It does not establish human balance or promote the rule automatically.
selectionRule.physicalBoundary: Any selected rule requires synchronized player-facing copy, scoring aids, browser behavior, tests, a fresh release candidate, and explicit user approval.

surfaceAudit.canonicalRulebook: no change; this is a simulation-only candidate
surfaceAudit.tests: latest Production snapshot and final scoring probe covered
